question.text: The optical rotation of the <math><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi></math> -form of a pyranose is <math><mo>+</mo><mn>150</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>°</mo></math> , that of the <math><mi mathvariant="normal">β</mi></math> -form is <math><mo>+</mo><mn>52.8</mn><mo>°</mo></math> . In solution an equilibrium mixture of these anomers has an optical rotation of <math><mo>+</mo><mn>80.2</mn><mo>°</mo></math> . The percentage of the <math><mi mathvariant="normal">α</mi></math> -form in equilibrium mixture is

solution.text:
Let the percentage of α -form be X
150.7(X)+52.8(1-X)=+80.2
150.7X+52.8-52.8X=+80.2
97.9X=27.4
X=0.279=0.28
≈28%
